**Español**
Es muy importante prestar atención a posibles correos de parte de la organización en los días próximos al torneo. Se estará proporcionando una invitación a un grupo de WhatsApp para coordinaciones urgentes durante el torneo, y también información útil para competidores nuevos. Si alguien no tiene acceso al correo asociado a su cuenta en la WCA, deje una dirección de correo válida en la caja de comentarios al registrarse.

**English**
It's important to check your email as the competition approaches. An invite to a WhatsApp group for day-of coordination will be sent, as well as useful information for new competitors. If you do not have access to your WCA email account, please leave your new email address in the comments box during registration.

organisers.name: Pedro Gabriel Alegre Pereira da Trindade

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTkxNDc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--af87e521c6e6fb4bf8a2afcd05e05a31d286336e/Alterado.png)
**Aviso de Filmagens:**
Serão tiradas fotos e gravados vídeos durante o Portugal Championship 2026, por isso ao participares estás a consentir que a APS utilize a tua imagem nas suas redes sociais.
•

Atenção a inscrição só é confirmada após ter sido efetuado o pagamento. Após o pagamento, as inscrições têm de ser aprovadas manualmente antes de aparecerem na lista de inscritos.
•
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um desconto exclusivo de 20%, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2026#72891-associados-aps-aps-associates).
•

**Notice of filming:**
Be aware that filming and photography at the Portugal Championship 2026 will be prevelant, you therefore consent to your image being used by APS in their social media platforms by attending.
•

Attention your registration is only confirmed after payment has been made. After payment, registrations must be manually approved before appearing on the registration list.
•
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an exclusive 20% discount, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortugalChampionship2026#72891-associados-aps-aps-associates).

**🚨Registo no dia🚨**
Esta competição vai ter registo no dia. Se planeias registar-te no dia da competição, envia um email com os eventos em que tencionas participar. Enviar email simplifica muito o nosso processo para no dia conseguirmos ter tudo pronto para os competidores e para poderem participar nos eventos que quiserem. Se consegues estar presente, queres competir, e não estás registado, envia-nos um email(*portugalchampionship2026@gmail.com*) assim que possível.
**🚨 Registration on the spot🚨**
This competition will have on the spot registration. If you plan to register on the stop, please email us with the events you plan to compete in. This email is very important to us in order to simplify our work before the competition and accomodate all competitors and the events they want to compete in. If you are able to attend, want to compete, but did not register, email(*portugalchampionship2026@gmail.com*) us as soon as possible.

ใครจะมาชิงตำแหน่ง "แชมป์รูบิกประเทศไทย ประจำปี 2026" ไปกันแน่? สมัครการแข่งขันและมาร่วมลุ้นด้วยตาของคุณเอง แล้วพบกัน!

Who will be crowned as the 2026 Thai Speedcubing Champion? There's only one way to find out. Register now and see it for yourself. See you at the competition!

--------------------------------------------------------------------

- การมอบรางวัลจะแบ่งออกเป็น 2 ประเภท ได้แก่ รางวัลรวมและรางวัลสำหรับผู้เข้าแข่งขันสัญชาติไทย
- จำนวนผู้เข้าแข่งขันที่ผ่านเข้ารอบในรอบชิงชนะเลิศอาจมีการเปลี่ยนแปลง จนกว่าจะมีผู้เข้าแข่งขันสัญชาติไทยอย่างน้อย 8 คน หรืออย่างน้อย 50% ของจำนวนผู้เข้าแข่งขันในรอบถัดไป (ขึ้นอยู่กับว่าจำนวนใดน้อยกว่า)

- There will be two podium categories: Overall and Thai National.
- The number of competitors in the final round may be adjusted until at least 8 Thai competitors advance, or until Thai competitors fill at least 50% of the spots in the final round (whichever is lower).
